description: This class, ConceptSetsEditor, is a Java property editor for converting a space-separated string of concept IDs into a collection of ConceptSet objects. It manages adding, updating, and removing ConceptSet instances within a collection based on the input string, typically for form data processing in the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: ConceptSetsEditor
classes.description: A property editor that converts a string of concept IDs into a list of ConceptSet objects, facilitating editing of concept sets.

methods.name: ConceptSetsEditor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the editor with the current set of concepts on a concept.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses a space-separated string of concept IDs and updates the collection of ConceptSet objects accordingly, adding new concepts, removing missing ones, and normalizing weights.
